sections.text:
Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Heals all allies for 10% of their max HP every 5 seconds for 30 seconds.
Recovery effect boosted by 5% for each increase in Skill level.
-Nullifies any Unison gauge reduction effects on all allies for 60 seconds.
-Removes status ailments from all allies.
-Applies a continuous buff that removes status ailments from all allies every 10 seconds for 60 seconds.
-Applies a continuous buff that fills the Unison gauge of all allies by 5 every 10 seconds for 60 seconds.
-Removes 5 Cost from all allies [demerit].
-Increases the Ability Power of all allies' star Unison damage by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Casts resurrection on your character.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000

[Additional Unison Effect] Casts Frenzy (nullifies debuffs and status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking) on all allied Archers and Treasure Hunters for 60 seconds.

Mortal Sin of Sloth Belvia or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
